ideas.idea: Add alt text to hero image (Home.jsx)
ideas.why: This duplicates the known missing-alt problem, so it adds nothing new.

ideas.idea: Give catalogue items richer content, such as a page per mug with price, size and material, plus Product structured data
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx renders only bare names in paragraphs, so per-product pages and structured data would give machines real content.

ideas.idea: Add a meta viewport tag to index.html
ideas.why: index.html does lack a viewport tag, but this applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page to the catalogue
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no links, so a crawlable link from Home to /catalogue gives crawlers and visitors a path.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description once prerendered
ideas.why: All routes share the single 'Vite App' title in index.html, so per-route titles and descriptions would help.

ideas.idea: Make pages readable without JavaScript via prerendering, and the catalogue data too
ideas.why: This repeats the known client-side rendering problem, though it adds that the catalogue data loads via fetch.

ideas.idea: Declare the site domain and add an absolute canonical tag
ideas.why: No canonical tag or domain exists in the repo, so declaring both is a concrete, accurate step.

ideas.idea: Use a Link instead of the navigate() button for Catalogue
ideas.why: This is the known button-not-link problem restated.
This is the known Disallow: / problem restated.
